capabilities: Sync a vault between desktops via a Cloudflare R2 bucket
Encrypt file contents, paths, and modification times end-to-end
Resolve three-way sync conflicts with copies or last-modified wins
Confirm before overwriting or deleting a large share of files
Filter synced files by glob ignore paths and a size limit
extras: Desktop only (Linux and macOS), requires Obsidian 1.13.2 or later. The encryption format has not been third-party audited; forgetting the password makes the remote copy unrecoverable, though local vaults stay intact. Free and MIT licensed; installation is by manual download or self-build, with a fish install script.
intentEvidence: R2V2 narrows the target to R2 and makes encryption mandatory.
problem: Syncing a vault through a storage provider normally exposes file names, contents, and timestamps, and existing byoc sync plugins make encryption optional.

relations.evidence: BYOC supports twelve storage services and makes encryption optional. R2V2 narrows the target to R2
the approach of BYOC and of Remotely Save, which it is based on
The rules follow the specification of the Unison file synchronizer

requires.name: Cloudflare account with an R2 bucket and API token
Cloudflare R2 usage beyond the free tier

summary: Vault-sync plugin that syncs a desktop vault through a Cloudflare R2 bucket with mandatory end-to-end encryption of contents, file names, and modification times.
